To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

feature-based explanations leak information that is at least as sensitive as model predictions, and that record-based explanations leak information about the training data that is significantly more sensitive than model predictions.

(1) feature-based explanations can be exploited to infer membership to the training set with the same power as model predictions and (2) record-based explanations can reconstruct significant parts of sensitive data.
(1) feature-based explanations can be exploited for membership inference attacks, and (2) record-based explanations can leak sensitive information about individuals in the training data.

the question whether transparency in machine learning is a double-edged sword.
